chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever has a newborn child, let him call the Adhan (call to prayer) in his right ear and the Iqamah in his left ear, for it is a protection from the demon.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic practice for newborns regarding the Adhan and Iqamah?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Adhan and Iqamah as a primordial invocation (dhikr) placed in the newborn's ears to counteract the devil's whisper, reflecting the Shia emphasis on spiritual purification from birth. It underscores the belief that the Quranic words recited at the onset of life serve as a divine shield (ismah) against evil influences, linking the child's physical entry into the world with immediate spiritual anchoring.
